span.p:
Result: Agent continues, state may
diverge, eventual merge
Use when: Chat assistants,
recommendations, summarization

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Result: Agent stops, returns error,
no partial state
Use when: Financial transactions,
compliance, audit trails

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center; width: 900px;

span.p: The agent system must choose: safety (stop and report) or resilience (continue with potentially inconsistent state).
